body:
## What it does

It is upfront about where it stands: coverage is framed from a conservative viewpoint and it says so instead of claiming neutrality. Expect a morning summary, alerts as stories develop, and longer pieces on politics, economics and overseas affairs. Treat it as one perspective among several, not the whole picture. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @zxnbluehandus shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
